description: This file defines an enumeration GatewayDiscoveryPreferences that manages user preferences related to gateway stable ID storage and retrieval using UserDefaults. It includes methods for getting and setting a preferred stable ID, handling legacy key compatibility, and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: preferredStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred stable ID from UserDefaults, considering legacy key and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: setPreferredStableID
methods.description: Sets or clears the preferred stable ID in UserDefaults, handling whitespace trimming and legacy key removal.
